name: AK11P - Indoor PM2.5 Meter & Particle Counter (PM2.5, Temperature, Humidity), Laser Sensor
highlights: Laser Particle Counting — A laser scattering module with a fan-drawn sample path — the sensor class that produces a µg/m³ figure worth acting on, not an inferred estimate.
Single-Purpose PM2.5 — One large reading with a colour band. For anyone auditing an air purifier, judging filter change intervals, or checking whether a window should stay shut.
Responds in Seconds — Particulate levels move the moment a door opens, a candle is lit or a purifier starts. The reading follows in real time, which is what makes cause and effect visible.
1200 mAh, 6–8 Hours — 238 g — the heaviest of the AK11 family, because the laser module and its airflow path take space a gas sensor does not.
50 Per Carton — Retail colour box with manual, USB-C cable and lanyard; same outer carton as the rest of the AK11 range.
